leave_sick_days_001.evidence: District employees retain any sick leave accumulated as state minimum sick leave under former Section 13.904(a) of the Education Code.

leave_sick_accrual_002.evidence: Local leave shall accumulate without limit.

leave_sick_family_003.evidence: Accumulated state sick leave shall be used only for the following: ... 2. Illness of a member of the employee’s immediate family.

leave_personal_days_004.answer: 7 total (5 state personal leave days + 2 local leave days per school year)
leave_personal_days_004.evidence: A district shall provide employees with five days per year of state personal leave... All employees shall receive two paid local leave days per school year

leave_personal_restrictions_005.answer: Requires written advance request; supervisor considers effect on educational program and substitute availability; restricted on state-mandated assessment days and other days as communicated by supervisors.
leave_personal_restrictions_005.evidence: No employee shall be granted discretionary use of state personal leave on days scheduled for state-mandated assessments. Individual supervisors may also restrict the use of state personal leave for discretionary purposes on other days.

leave_personal_conversion_006.answer: No conversion to sick leave during employment; reimbursed as cash upon voluntary retirement (max 20 days, 10 years service required).
leave_personal_conversion_006.evidence: The employee shall be reimbursed for each day of unused state and local leave, to a maximum of 20 days, at the employee’s daily rate of pay immediately preceding retirement.
